_scheme: Every store link carries the slug of the page it sits on: the path with index.html, .html and a leading apps/ dropped, slashes as dashes; the home page is 'home', /apps/ is 'apps'.
App Store: ?pt=<appStoreProviderToken>&ct=<campaignPrefix><slug>&mt=8 (pt is left out while the token is empty; ct is shortened with a hash past maxCampaignLength).
Paste the numeric provider token above, then run python3 scripts/store-links.py (the deploy workflow also runs it on every push).
